anti_overlap: fd-bevy-input-state-revisit covers which Bevy API primitives drive the transitions — this agent focuses on the state machine logic, not the input API
fd-game-ux-conventions covers whether Stack model + Direct Switch match player expectations — this agent focuses on logical correctness of the transition graph
fd-selection-polymorphism-revisit covers Selection enum consumers — this agent focuses on OverlayState consumers (SystemSet predicates, Resume handler)
decision_lens: Is the two-field OverlayState model sufficient to represent all reachable states implied by the 9 locked decisions, or are there ghost states (e.g. pause_menu=true with screen=None and prior_paused=false when game was already paused) that produce incorrect sim-pause behavior on Resume?
focus: OverlayState two-field model correctness — prior_paused invariant across Stack model transitions, GatedInput/GatedCamera SystemSet predicate coverage, Direct Switch atomicity, and edge cases in the Esc/backtick/digit interaction matrix.
name: fd-overlay-state-machine
persona: Apply the perspective of a game-engine state machine architect who has implemented and debugged layered modal UI in shipped titles — they care about whether every reachable state in the (screen: Option<ScreenKind>, pause_menu: bool, prior_paused: bool) triple has a defined transition, measure correctness by exhaustive state-transition tabulation, and flag any path where prior_paused could be captured stale, where backtick could pop the wrong layer, or where Direct Switch leaves both overlays simultaneously active for a single frame.
review_areas: prior_paused capture: when Esc opens the pause menu, prior_paused must snapshot SimState.paused at that exact moment — if Esc is handled in the same system that reads OverlayState, the read order matters; verify the spec declares this clearly

Stack model exhaustive table: enumerate all (screen, pause_menu) pairs and verify that every legal Esc/backtick/digit input has a defined output state — the spec shows three paths but omits 'Esc while pause_menu already open' (should be no-op per just_pressed) and 'backtick while screen=None and pause_menu=false' (should be no-op)

Direct Switch atomicity: pressing Digit3 while screen=Some(Settlement) must close Settlement and open Relationships in one frame — if two systems each handle one half, there's a one-frame window where screen=None; check if any rendering system observes screen=None as 'game running' and draws the wrong thing

is_input_modal() predicate coverage: the brainstorm lists Space, Tab, sim-speed, picking clicks, Esc-quit branch as gated — verify the predicate covers all six system categories from M4, especially that quit_on_escape (Esc/Ctrl+Q) is partially gated (Esc only, not Ctrl+Q)

GatedCamera run_if predicate: camera_pan and camera_zoom must check is_pause_menu() not is_input_modal() per Option C — verify the predicate split is implemented at SystemSet level, not duplicated per-system

Resume/Quit button handlers: clicking Resume must set pause_menu=false and restore SimState.paused from prior_paused, then release — check the spec describes this restoration path and doesn't accidentally set paused=false unconditionally (which would unpause a game that was already paused before opening the menu)

severity_examples.condition: Always reproducible when the player presses Esc while already paused
severity_examples.scenario: prior_paused is captured after SimState.paused is modified by the same Esc handler — if the handler both reads and sets paused in one system, prior_paused captures the post-mutation value (false), so Resume always unpauses even if the game was paused before opening the menu

severity_examples.condition: Reproducible at 60fps; visible at normal play speed when switching overlays quickly
severity_examples.scenario: Direct Switch: the 'close old overlay' and 'open new overlay' are handled in separate systems scheduled in the same Update stage — for one frame screen=None is broadcast, causing tiles.rs compose_tiles to render without any selection highlight, producing a visible flash

severity_examples.condition: Reproducible whenever backtick is pressed while no overlay is open (e.g. muscle memory from other apps)
severity_examples.scenario: backtick while screen=None and pause_menu=false has no guard — triggers a default branch that sets screen=None again (no-op) but also calls info!() spam or resets an unrelated field, creating log noise or subtle state drift

success_hints: Draw the full (screen x pause_menu) state transition matrix: 4 ScreenKind values + None = 5, times bool = 10 states; for each of Esc/backtick/Digit1-6 inputs verify the target state is defined and matches the locked decisions
Check the Resume handler restores SimState.paused = overlay.prior_paused, not SimState.paused = false
Verify Direct Switch is handled in a single system or uses Commands with deferred application so screen never transiently equals None mid-frame
task_context: Reviewing the OverlayState design proposed in the Revel-14e locked-decisions document to verify the two-field model is logically complete, that the GatedInput/GatedCamera predicates are correctly split, and that the Stack model and Direct Switch transitions are free of ghost states or frame-boundary races before implementation begins.
